contexts.text: To go out to meet () = to submit himself.
He gave each his part to meet the other () = parallelism and correspondence as to celestial things.
Man on his part goes to meet this life which is from the Lord, through scientifics and Knowledges.
These (truths) the Lord goes to meet through good...
He rose up to meet them () = acknowledgement, and also the mood of charity.
Who is that man walking in the field to meet us? ()... To meet us = for conjunction.
He ran to meet him () = agreement... for it regards conjunction. Agreement, or likeness, conjoins.
Esau... goeth to meet thee () ... To come to meet = to inflow. Explained. AC 4350.
The Divine inflows through the internal man, and comes to meet truths... AC 4350.
He went up to meet Israel his father () = influx... Explained.

Lo (Aaron) goeth forth to meet thee () = reception. To go forth to meet, here, = to be presented prepared to receive Divine truth... thus the reception of it. Angels and Spirits who receive the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord, and further promote it, are said to go forth to meet, when they are presented by the Lord prepared to receive.
Go to meet Moses () = that he should be conjoined with the truth proceeding immediately from the Divine. To go to meet = to be conjoined. AC 7056.
Standing to meet them in their going out from Pharaoh () = manifestation then...
Moses went forth to meet his father-in-law () = the application of truth Divine to Divine good. Explained.
They had thought justly and rightly about things obvious; namely, about worldly things.
